quests.title: Raise the Ascendant altar
quests.text: Build an Ascendant altar from refined metal and carved stone in a cleared arena of radius 32.

quests.title: Ascendant I
quests.text: Defeat Antlered Hollow, Cauldron-Heart and Tide Reaver (any order).

quests.title: Ascendant II
quests.text: Defeat Foundry Sovereign, Mist Weaver and Ash Seraph.

quests.title: Ascendant III
quests.text: Defeat Dusk Wyrm, Rootbreaker and The Last Wheel.

quests.title: The Gauntlet
quests.text: Clear the boss rush once.

quests.title: Relentless
quests.text: Win any Ascendant I fight, then take the first Mode Stone.

quests.title: Merciless
quests.text: Clear the Gauntlet on Relentless.

quests.title: Ordeal
quests.text: Beat The Last Wheel on Merciless.

quests.title: Antlered Hollow: step 1
quests.text: The altar eats before it fights. Set one feast upon the stone, a dish worth a guest-gift.

quests.title: Antlered Hollow: step 2
quests.text: The hollow king shed his crown among the bones of the old herd. Lay sixteen at the foot of the stone.

quests.title: Antlered Hollow: step 3
quests.text: The dead of the wood walk his old trail. Let twenty fall in sight of the altar.

quests.title: Antlered Hollow: step 4
quests.text: Nine trees stand in the stone's mind. Seal them in this order, no other: the door-wood, the strong one; then the one that bleeds when it is cut; then red berries set against the witch.

quests.title: Antlered Hollow: step 5
quests.text: The stone will answer only when the moon stands highest over the stone. Use the altar then.

quests.title: Antlered Hollow: step 6
quests.text: Whatever you woke will come to see who woke it. Hold the altar for 60 breaths of the sun-count and do not leave it.

quests.title: Cauldron-Heart: step 1
quests.text: The altar eats before it fights. Set one feast upon the stone, a dish worth a guest-gift.

quests.title: Cauldron-Heart: step 2
quests.text: What boils in the heart must first be fed. Sixteen red-bark warts for the pot.

quests.title: Cauldron-Heart: step 3
quests.text: Eight-legged cooks stir the lower dark. Twenty of them must be unmade.

quests.title: Cauldron-Heart: step 4
quests.text: Nine trees stand in the stone's mind. Seal them in this order, no other: the door-wood, the strong one; then the pale one that wears the first white; then the winter king, green when all is grey; then the one that bleeds when it is cut.

quests.title: Cauldron-Heart: step 5
quests.text: The stone will answer only in the breath between night and the first light. Use the altar then.

quests.title: Cauldron-Heart: step 6
quests.text: Whatever you woke will come to see who woke it. Hold the altar for 60 breaths of the sun-count and do not leave it.

quests.title: Tide Reaver: step 1
quests.text: The altar eats before it fights. Set one feast upon the stone, a dish worth a guest-gift.

quests.title: Tide Reaver: step 2
quests.text: The drowned reaver's coat is made of sea-glass. Twenty-four shards, and no fewer.

quests.title: Tide Reaver: step 3
quests.text: The sea gives back its dead on the shore. Fifteen must go back to it.

quests.title: Tide Reaver: step 4
quests.text: Nine trees stand in the stone's mind. Seal them in this order, no other: kin of the tree that holds up the world; then the nut of the one who knows; then the one that bleeds when it is cut; then the nut of the one who knows.

quests.title: Tide Reaver: step 5
quests.text: The stone will answer only as the sun drowns and the first stars wake. Use the altar then.

quests.title: Tide Reaver: step 6
quests.text: Whatever you woke will come to see who woke it. Hold the altar for 75 breaths of the sun-count and do not leave it.

quests.title: Foundry Sovereign: step 2
quests.text: The Sovereign's hearth wants iron by the block: eight, cold and square.

quests.title: Foundry Sovereign: step 3
quests.text: Bones that never rusted still march in his smoke. Thirty is the count.

quests.title: Foundry Sovereign: step 4
quests.text: Nine trees stand in the stone's mind. Seal them in this order, no other: the weeper by the water; then the nut of the one who knows; then kin of the tree that holds up the world; then the winter king, green when all is grey; then red berries set against the witch.

quests.title: Foundry Sovereign: step 5

quests.title: Foundry Sovereign: step 6
quests.text: It will not wake for one hand. 2 must stand at the altar together, or the stone will take a token for every spirit that stands in for a friend.

quests.title: Foundry Sovereign: step 7
quests.text: Whatever you woke will come to see who woke it. Hold the altar for 90 breaths of the sun-count and do not leave it.

quests.title: Dusk Wyrm: step 3

quests.title: The Last Wheel: step 2

quests.title: The Last Wheel: step 3
